verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers an 'Agent view' explicitly described as 'One place to manage all your Claude Code sessions,' plus support for running multiple sessions side by side, spawning parallel subagents coordinated by a lead agent, cloud/browser sessions, scheduling, and remote control from phone/browser—directly matching the engineering-lead's need to oversee multiple concurrent agent sessions from one workspace. This is corroborated across multiple first-party doc pages describing parallel task execution and unified session management. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the unified 'Agent view' dashboard itself (community evidence is silent on this specific feature, only covering general CLI usage and code-quality complaints).
